text: I want chaos and drama: something crazy happening on screen, big visible disasters and their aftermath (tsunamis, impacts, things flying into space). "Interesting to look at" is not enough.
Use several locations (city, town, bay, sky, orbit), not one set. Full-colour people and places, not silhouettes.
Never repeat one of our own past videos or a popular niche video (no Sun-vanishing remakes).

title: What if gravity flipped for 5 seconds? (then 1 minute, then 10)
reason: escalating steps, multiple locations, aftermath disasters, planes flying into space

title: What if the Sun vanished (8-minute countdown)?
reason: a repeat of our own post and of a popular niche video
